notes: macOS field report and the desktop HUB. A first real Mac install surfaced eight issues; the product fixes behind them: aidog doctor no longer calls a keyless 401 unreachable (any status below 500 now counts as answered, the same rule the console's own endpoint probe already used) and no longer fails an archive install for having no .git (it reports SKIP - a codeload zip is a legitimate path). A Feishu allowlist entry starting with cli_ is now refused at save time with an actionable reason, because that id is the bot's own app and letting it in makes the bot answer itself forever; and a Feishu channel with no chat_ids now says so on its status row instead of showing configured while polling nothing. macOS itself is a verified runtime as of 2026-11-12 (macOS 26 arm64, Miniconda, conda tmux) - the site, both READMEs and the install guide now state that fact and the exact path to reproduce it, including the codeload fallback when GitHub's git endpoint is blocked. Desktop HUB: the README's stale claim that Windows was never built is corrected (it has been built and selftest-verified since car J), the site gains an independent Desktop HUD section with an honest three-platform matrix and Release download, macOS build configuration is added (pack:mac - compiling it still needs a real Mac), and a dual-platform manual test checklist ships unticked until a human actually runs it. Docs: installation guide macOS section, platform matrix wording, desktop client checklist. Quality: core 2494/2494, console smoke 558/558, setup wizard 123/123, locale packs 1555 per pack, site packs 395, publish gate READY, E2E batch 35/3 (the two known helpers plus one host-networking timeout on this machine's IPv4 loopback, diagnosed and documented - not a product regression).
